sentences.text: London Cooking sits on top of the title race with 16.8% title odds.
Bo Girds is breathing down its neck at 16.3% title odds, 2nd in the league.
Maye d'force B with U ranks 3rd with 14.5% title odds.
All You Need Is Love owns the standings at 11-5, and its title odds still rank just 6th.
The model remains unconvinced.
All You Need Is Love leads the league at 11-5 and has won 3 straight head-to-head games.
Bo Girds is still 3rd, but has lost 4 head-to-head games in a row.
Return of T Mac has won 5 straight head-to-head and still sits on just 43% playoff odds.
At the bottom, NFC Least is living up to the name at 3-13, with 1% playoff odds.
The name checks out.
All You Need Is Love has the Wire to wire arc: 6-2 in weeks 1 to 4 and 5-3 in weeks 5 to 8.
All You Need Is Love sits at +2.73 on Schedule luck, and a 2-0 record in close games keeps the good fortune rolling.
Bo Girds has scored like a team with 5.18 wins if it played everyone and has just 3 head-to-head wins to show for it.
Brutal draw.
To Infinity and Bijan has eaten 947.27 points against, the most in the league, so even Bijan cannot outrun that slate.
Teehee would own a better record with 5 other schedules than with its own.
behold the lamb would gain 4 wins with the schedule of Maye d'force B with U.
Maye d'force B with U live up to the name, with Drake Maye 3rd among quarterbacks and Jahmyr Gibbs leading all running backs at 178.8.
Isaiah Likely is on that same roster too, right behind Brock Bowers at tight end.
Josh Allen leads all quarterbacks for behold the lamb, while the actual Lamb, CeeDee, ranks 2nd among receivers for NFC Least.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba tops every receiver at 187.96 for Lil Fridge through week 8.
The Tampa Bay Buccaneers rank 3rd among defenses at 77.75 and are still a free agent.
Somebody check the wire.
NFC Least landed Jalen Coker for $1.
Coker now sits on 64.9 points for somebody else's lineup math.
Unsolicited Dak Picks paid $39 for A.J. Brown and got 13.6 points back.
That bust is tagged just bad, so there is no injury to hide behind.
The Blue Tent spent $46 on De'Von Achane and has 21.1 points to show for it.
Rough auction.
Ollie Gordon II went to Unsolicited Dak Picks for $40 in week 3: 4 starts, 30.3 points over the line, and 1 swung wins. He is the 1st waiver hit of the league.
To Infinity and Bijan shipped Bijan Robinson out in week 7 and still won that deal clearly, landing Malik Nabers and Breece Hall in return.
That one sits 34.2 points over the line since.
The week 1 robbery belongs to Maye d'force B with U, whose Jalen Coker and D'Andre Swift haul is 82.9 points over the line since.
NFC Least took MarShawn Lloyd and Rhamondre Stevenson on the other side of it and has gone 3-13 since.
Some deals age badly.
Bo Girds pulled a robbery of their own in week 3, landing Kyren Williams for a net of 46.5 points over the line.

awards.title: MVP
awards.fact: Jahmyr Gibbs of Maye d'force B with U has 135.1 points over the line in his starts, the most of any QB, RB, WR, or TE.

awards.title: Streaming king
awards.fact: Return of T Mac started 4 streamed QBs, kickers, and defenses 11 times for 174.4 points, the most in the league.

awards.title: Bench crime of the year
awards.fact: London Cooking lost to Unsolicited Dak Picks by 1.67 in week 2 with 27.54 points on the bench, the most in a loss its best lineup would have won.

awards.title: Heartbreak of the year
awards.fact: The Blue Tent lost to All You Need Is Love by 0.4 in week 3, the closest head-to-head game of the season.

awards.title: Beatdown of the year
awards.fact: Maye d'force B with U beat To Infinity and Bijan by 92.14 in week 5, the biggest head-to-head margin of the season.

awards.title: Most active
awards.fact: Bo Girds made 42 moves, adds and trades, the most in the league.

awards.title: Set and forget
awards.fact: London Cooking made 3 moves, the fewest in the league, and is 9-7.

sentences.text: Maye d'force B with U hold the highest score of the season, a 158.96.
That same week they beat To Infinity and Bijan by 92.14, the biggest head-to-head margin of the year.
The Bijan side then hit the season low in week 6 with 46.08.
London Cooking lost to Unsolicited Dak Picks by 1.67 while 27.54 points sat on the bench, the most in any loss a better lineup would have won.
They also made the fewest moves in the league, just 3, and somehow sit 9-7.
The Blue Tent lost the closest head-to-head game of the season to All You Need Is Love.
Lil Fridge is the headline here: 85.02 points left on the bench, 5th most in the league.
The ugly one came against Return of T Mac, an 11.84-point loss with 14.7 sitting on the bench, enough for the right lineup to win it.
Teehee managed this trick twice, including a loss to To Infinity and Bijan by 0.51 with 18.1 points in reserve.
Agonizing.
The Blue Tent can relate, falling to All You Need Is Love by 0.4 with the winning points parked on the bench.
NFC Least still owns the bench crown outright at 119.8 points.
behold the lamb lost 9 starter games to injury through week 8, the most in the league.
Kyle Monangai missed 4 of those games as a starter.
The Blue Tent ranked 2nd on this list, losing 5 starter games.
Davante Adams missed 2 of them.
Bo Girds, Teehee and Unsolicited Dak Picks lost 0 starter games all season.
Must be nice.
Maye d'force B with U drew the softest schedule left on the board, with opponents at a 0.44 win rate.
The Blue Tent sits 2nd softest at 0.46, so the easy road comes with shade.
Lil Fridge and Unsolicited Dak Picks share the 3rd softest path, both facing a 0.47 win rate.
Return of T Mac gets little relief, with the 11th softest slate at 0.55.
Then there's behold the lamb, handed the hardest schedule in the league at a 0.56 win rate.
Pray for that roster.
